penguinStatistics.penguinStatisticsDescription:
Penguin Statistics is the Department of Data Analysis of Penguin Logistics (not really). We devote ourselves to item drop analysis.
Penguin Statistics' current dataset is maintained through a combination of player manual reports, screenshot recognitions, and other uploads via public APIs. The Penguin Statistics team performs various types of automatic, scheduled, and manual maintenance to ensure the dataset's accuracy.

yiTuLiu.description: Arknights Yituliu aims to provide various in-game resource cost-effectiveness guides for doctors, including but not limited to farming recommendations, shop value, pull saving calculator, and many small tools.
